text: Calling about my grandson, he's 2. He's had runny nappies since yesterday but he's drinking well and weeing as normal, so I wasn't too bothered by that. What I'm less sure of is his colour tonight. His skin's gone pale and patchy, sort of mottled over his legs and tummy, and his lips look greyish to me. Also he keeps putting his hands over his eyes and fussing when the big light is on, he wants it off. Thought I'd better ask.
